reviews.text: Such great attention from everyone there, specially Galdy, My baby dog Tango, came out gorgeous after his spa. Thank you guys, wonderful work.

My family has been taking our pets here for years. They are amazing! I always got complaints from other groomers about the first dog I brought. Galdy came out and told me how good he was the very first time I brought him. The entire staff clearly loves animals, and they are great with rescues. My cats even love going. I'm very grateful to them for helping me take care of my babies.

I had to last second board 2 of my cats and they were quick to respond and also eased my anxiety immediately with quick and precise instructions and even helped me when I needed to add an extra day. I got my cats back and reunited them with my other pets and they were pretty much back to normal in no time at all. I didn't ask for any grooming services, but they did just smell better than normal and feel softer, so they keep the place very clean and fresh. I'll definitely be going back here, everyone was so nice.
They have always been really great to my dog ..I won't never take my dog anywhere else to get her nails or a bath ..love the staff
Absolutely a neighborhood treasure. My dog adores the staff. He tries to drag me inside whenever we walk by. Prices are very reasonable and the keep my little pup clean and fluffy.

I took my kitten here for the first time on June 13 2026. When I picked her up a few hours later, a staff member informed me that scratched him. She was already in her carrier so I apologized, paid and left. When I arrived home I realized my kitten's right front paw was injured and she could not walk. I had to rush her to emergency services to be evaluated. I immediately called Galdy and asked what happened and of course they claimed to have no recollection. It turns out that  the employee that she scratched intentionally hurt her and caused extensive damage to her paw. I have filed a formal complaint with the BBB as well. I hope this review saves another precious kitty from being harmed by ignorant untrained staff at this business.

Grooming by Galdy was prompt, professional and friendly. They groomed my extra large and not calm cat. They told me it would be two hours, it was one hour. They charged me the lower end of my quoted range. Five stars.
I drive from far away (30+ mins) to take my elderly pups here. Galdy’s does an amazing job and my girls come out happy and calm.
Been bringing my Persian cat there for years  They are fantastic with cats. And patient with not so attentive guardians.

“This is a truly wonderful grooming and bathing shop for dogs. The owner and groomers are incredibly attentive, treating every pup — every little family member — with great care and attention to detail. I highly recommend this lovely place to anyone in Rogers Park or the Edgewater area.”
Always an amazing haircut for the pup. Excellent customer service too.
Great job
Our dog always looks and smells wonderful after being groomed here! They are very kind and the prices are very reasonable! We will definitely be bringing our dog back!

they took my lil guy from looking like a wookie as seen in the first pic to a cutie handsome distinguished gentleman! they are so kind and so honest! i will definitely be back! can’t believe i went to other places before! this place is truly a gem! my little guy is difficult too and they did amazing!!! can’t recommend enough!! 💗
Wonderful service and such a wonderful shop. Left my dog looking so cute and refreshed! Recommended 100%

I love the service and boarding for Nakitta my Husky,if she could talk she would tell anyone how much she enjoys going there and boarding at Galdys when I go out of town.Top notch service and happiness for my dog

I’ve brought by dog here several times since she was a puppy, and we always had a good experience. I’m not sure who cut her hair last time, but my baby got her hair cut about 2 weeks ago and we are finding so many big scabs on her head! They are clearly painful and bleeding. This is just unacceptable and I am really disappointed with whoever cut her hair.
They do a great job with grooming my dog.

I must say OSCAR award winning receptionist and scheduler. He goes up and beyond to make sure he is treated for. The owner even speaks to you one on one for first timers. They treat you like family. Go to them. They are the best! Keep on going!!!

They did an amazing job on Will O' Wisp! She can be wiggly in the bath but they managed.

The last groomer we went to traumatized her so I'm happy we found Galdys! They were really good with her and she looks amazing! Of course she immediately rolled in dirt but we can't wait to see them in 3 months! ❤️❤️❤️❤️
Honestly, the best groomers I've taken my dog to. Thank you so much guys; you were great!!!
Really great employees. Awesome job on taking care of Charlie! He is a Bernedoodle and in much needed for a summer cut! Summer cut looks amazing! Thanks again!
Two cats that go to this groomer. Very good experience.

I am extremely disappointed with the service I received at Galdy. I dropped off my cat for grooming, and within an hour, I received a call saying they couldn't do anything because my cat was too aggressive.

When I got home, I noticed that one of his nails had been cut way too deep, causing damage to his nerve. It’s no wonder the poor cat was so upset! He was clearly in pain and stressed out.

It’s going to take a long time before my cat trusts anyone close enough to handle his nails again. I will never be bringing him back here, and I highly recommend finding a more professional and considerate groomer if you care about your pet’s well-being.

We’ve been going to Galdy for almost 10 years. They are so amazing, they treat our dogs with such care I never have a worry. When we rescued our first dog 10 years ago we were taking them to another local groomer and were told he was so bad (the third time we brought him there), they were going to have to use 4 people and charge us double. A neighbor recommended Galdy and I’m so glad they did. After his first grooming there, I asked Galdy if he was ok, expecting him to tell me he wasn’t well behaved. He chuckled and said of course! He’s just a little feisty drama queen but we love it! Little diva can come back anytime! And we knew that was where we needed to take them. We now have another dog and they are excellent with him too. They listen, do exactly the grooming style you ask for, and they call with any questions or updates along the way. We now have moved further away and still make the trip to Galdy because it’s the only place our little divas will go ;)
They are the best!!
They do a great job grooming our two Persian cats. They always look very cute and smell fresh! 🐱 …

Galdy is the very Best Groomer in Chicago !!! My beautiful Zeus has been going to him since he was a puppy and will be 15 in February, he loves Galdy gets so excited thinks Galdy is his Uncle I highly recommend him for all of your pet needs and he has a Daycare the only one I would trust with Zeus , and he's so kind and even forgives Zeus for attempted shop lifting 😍😂Zeus is highly intuitive and trusts and Loves his Tio .....
Walk-in doesn't mean walk-in here. I'm not blasting them with a 1star review only because they did great with my last dog (when I had an appointment and didn't try to WALK IN)
This place is the best! They have great prices, amazing service, and a friendly staff that cares about your fur baby’s safety. I highly recommend them!

They did a great job with my older cat. She went in looking (and feeling) rather drab, came back to us looking (and smelling) fab.

To be clear, she has arthritis, and therefore has trouble grooming. They were able to bathe her and comb out her tangles.

So grateful and definitely plan on using their service again.
